finding: The first-pass label overstates completion. The rules require access without waitlist approval or special codes. Waymo says it is only steadily offering access to more riders, is still working toward opening service to everyone, and tells users to wait for an email or notification when their turn arrives. General-public access is therefore pending.

source.quote: Keep an eye on your email and notifications, we’ll let you know as soon as it's your turn as we work quickly to open our service to everyone.
